description:
Pédalons is the home of your cycling club or group: rides, routes, the agenda and team news, all in one place.

RIDES
• Every ride offers its pace groups: sign up for yours in one tap, and see who is riding with whom.
• Start location and time, planned route, comments: everything you need to know before heading out.
• The ride's weather in the week before it: at the start, then along the route at your group's pace — rain, temperature, and headwind or tailwind, point by point, right on the map.
• Multi-day trips, stage by stage, with the weather for each stage.

ROUTES
• The club's route library, on the map or as a list, filtered by distance and elevation; Explore opens the map of every route of your teams.
• An elevation profile coloured by gradient or by surface, and the climbs along the way.
• The route's points on the map and the profile: regroups, food stops, water, cafés, summits, hazards…
• Download as GPX or FIT, and send a route to your Hammerhead Karoo or Garmin bike computer — or have routes sent automatically, service by service.

THE TEAM
• Each team's dashboard: your next rides, the latest posts, new routes and ads.
• The agenda of rides and trips, as a list or a calendar, which you can subscribe to from your own calendar app.
• Club posts, to keep everyone in the loop.
• Classified ads between members, without your e-mail address ever being shown.
• Notifications for ride reminders, schedule changes and replies to your comments, set type by type.

A Pédalons account is created with an e-mail address; sign-in works with a password, a one-time code or passkeys.
whatsNew:
• Every group of a ride has its own page: overview, weather, who is riding and sign-up. The group you ride with comes first in the list.
• Weather on the map: headwind or tailwind along the route, and badges at checkpoints with the expected rain. A group's Weather tab gives it at the group's pace, map on top.
• A ride's detail shows the weather at the start, and each group card its own weather line. A ride with a single group brings everything together on one page; trips get their weather on the map too.
• A ride's map draws each group's route and shows its direction; a trip stage's map opens full screen.
• Routes show their surface and their points: regroups, food stops, water, summits…
• Routes can be sent automatically to your Garmin or Karoo bike computer, service by service.
• Explore opens the route map, and the team name lets you switch between your teams.
• Organizers and administrators create and edit rides in the app (places, groups, leaders, images, attachments) and manage ride templates. A route is created or updated by sending a GPX file.
• A lighter dashboard and profile, dates in the language chosen in the app, website pages opened in your device's browser.
